newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian working hours lost rise 112.2 pct in 96.
newsitem.headline: Italian working hours lost rise 112.2 pct in 96.

text.p: The number of working hours in Italy lost as a result of industrial action and on other grounds rose 112.2 percent in 1996 to 13.5 million hours from 6.4 million in 1995, statistics institute ISTAT said on Wednesday.

Stoppages in support of contract negotiations and other economic bargaining accounted for 88.3 percent of hours lost. The majority of stoppages, 78.7 percent, occurred in the manufacturing industries, ISTAT said.
In January 1997, hours lost rose to 2.1 million from 0.3 million in January 1996.
